_note: Original one-line summaries of gear picks, keyed by table name. Our own wording; see the cited pages for rules.

summaries.Bug, audio: Hidden microphone that transmits; its PR is its signal strength.
summaries.Bug, video: Hidden camera that transmits; low-PR models send grainy monochrome.
summaries.Bug, tracer: Sends only a locator signal, for following whoever carries it.
summaries.Computer, desktop: Fixed workstation; its result cap applies to checks made with it.
summaries.Computer, laptop: Portable computer; its result cap applies to checks made with it.
summaries.Computer software: One program; running programs may total at most 2 × the host's PR.
summaries.Software, Anti-Virus: Cuts the PR of attacking Virus software by its own PR.
summaries.Software, Probe: Hacking program used to probe a target system (p.371).
summaries.Software, Security: Gives its computer a Security PR equal to the program's PR.
summaries.Software, Trace: Hacking program used to trace a connection (p.371).
summaries.Software, Virus: Lowers a target computer's PR by its own PR once delivered.
summaries.Goggles: Hands-free optics with one built-in mode: night, telescopic or thermal.
summaries.Microphone, parabolic: Extends the listener's base hearing range.
summaries.Microphone, laser: Hear around a thin target surface as if there; stay still to use.
summaries.Police Scanner: Picks up local police radio traffic.
summaries.Radio, tactical or headset: Short-range team radio; one pick equips every team member.
summaries.Radio, tactical or headset (encrypted): Team radio whose traffic needs a Decipher check (DC 5 × PR) to read.
summaries.Radio, base: Fixed radio station; uses the signal and jamming rules (p.276).
summaries.Radio, satellite: Satellite-relayed radio; uses the signal and jamming rules (p.276).
summaries.Receiver, audio/video: Picks up audio and video transmissions, such as from bugs.
summaries.Transceiver, audio/video: Sends and receives audio and video transmissions.
summaries.Voice modulator: Disguises the user's voice; unmasking it takes 3 Examine Media clues.
summaries.Bomb sniffer, commercial: Searches for explosives without sight and with its own result cap.
summaries.Bomb sniffer, military: Searches for explosives without sight and with its own result cap.
summaries.Bug sweeper, commercial: Searches for bugs without sight and with its own result cap.
summaries.Bug sweeper, military: Searches for bugs without sight and with its own result cap.
summaries.GPS unit, commercial: Gives position, altitude, speed and heading, precise to its range.
summaries.GPS unit, military: Gives position, altitude, speed and heading, precise to its range.
summaries.Radar unit, portable: Handheld radar sensor; uses the signal rules (p.276).
summaries.Sonar unit, portable: Handheld sonar sensor; uses the signal rules (p.276).
summaries.Tap, physical: Wired phone tap; callers may notice clicking (DC 20 each minute).
summaries.Tap, wireless: Phone tap that transmits once fitted; harder to notice (DC 30).
summaries.Tap detector, physical: Fitted to a phone, makes a tap 5 easier to spot.
summaries.Tap detector, wireless: Fitted to a phone, makes a tap 5 easier to spot.
summaries.Jammer: Broadcasts interference that weakens other signals in range.
summaries.Laser designator: Allows Aim actions when making a guided weapon attack.
summaries.Stress analyzer, voice: +1 gear bonus to Sense Motive/Detect Lie checks.
summaries.Stress analyzer, retina: +3 gear bonus to Sense Motive/Detect Lie checks.
summaries.Cellular interceptor: Undetectable tap on a cell call in progress; needs 10 minutes of setup.
summaries.TEMPEST interceptor: Shows one nearby computer's screen after Electronics (DC 30).
summaries.SATCOM Terminal (encrypted): Paired encrypted relays for global audio, video and data (DC 40).
summaries.Attack: Gadget attack: 1d6 per PR of one damage type; a blast version is single-use.
summaries.Attribute boost: Raises one chosen attribute by its PR and lifts related result caps.
summaries.Burrow: Gives the user or the housing the burrow quality.
summaries.Chemical transfer: Delivers one loaded chemical sample to a person or surface.
summaries.Common Item, miniature: Builds one Common Item into the housing at reduced size and weight.
summaries.Damage reduction: Gives the user DR/— equal to its PR.
summaries.Damage resistance: Resistance against one chosen damage type, equal to its PR.
summaries.Damage save boost: Raises the housing's Damage save bonus.
summaries.Defense boost: Raises the user's Defense by its PR.
summaries.Disguised gadget: Adds its PR to the Knowledge DC for recognizing the gadget.
summaries.Durable gadget: Adds its PR to the gadget's own Damage save.
summaries.EMP: Shorts out electronics in range; rated devices resist on a d10 roll.
summaries.EMP hardening (device): Shields one electronic device from EMP.
summaries.Flight: Powered flight at 60 ft.; must keep moving, with limited turns.
summaries.Gear pick, miniature: Builds one non-vehicle gear pick into the housing at reduced size.
summaries.Gear pick, miniature: Ahead of its time: Allows a miniature pick from up to one decade ahead per Caliber.
summaries.Gear pick, miniature: Battery life boost: Extends how long the miniature pick runs, or how far it goes.
summaries.Gear pick, miniature: Power Rating boost: Raises the miniature pick's Power Rating.
summaries.Gear pick, miniature: Result cap boost: Raises the miniature pick's result cap modifier.
summaries.Gear pick, miniature: Upgraded: Adds up to 3 suitable upgrades to the miniature pick.
summaries.Healing: A minute of use restores PR wounds and 1d8 vitality per PR.
summaries.Hidden compartment: Concealed space for one smaller item (Search DC 25 to find).
summaries.Hologram, static: Projects a recorded still image; seeing through it is DC 5 × PR.
summaries.Hologram, moving: Projects recorded moving images; seeing through it is DC 5 × PR.
summaries.Incinerator, low-grade: Burns what is in the housing or compartment, leaving no evidence.
summaries.Incinerator, high-grade: Burns sturdier contents of the housing, leaving no evidence.
summaries.Incorporeal: Makes the user intangible: physical attacks pass through.
summaries.Invisibility: Makes the user or one item up to Medium invisible.
summaries.Media-safe (gadget): Keeps the gadget out of recordings.
summaries.Media-safe (gadget user): Keeps the gadget's user out of recordings.
summaries.Proteus modification: Lets the housing change into a second housing of the same Size.
summaries.Regeneration: A minute of use heals one critical injury.
summaries.Remote control: Operate the gadget from a distance with a remote.
summaries.Remote control (with movement): Remote operation, and the housing can walk at 20 ft.
summaries.Self-destruct, remnants: Destroys the gadget in an obvious flash; remains can be studied.
summaries.Self-destruct, traceless: Destroys the gadget and leaves nothing to study.
summaries.Sensor mask: Lowers the PR of two chosen sensor types against the user.
summaries.Silence: Makes the user or one item silent; hampers unseen listeners.
summaries.Skill boost: Raises one chosen skill by its PR and lifts its result cap.
summaries.Skill check: Makes one chosen skill check at PR × 4 with no result cap.
summaries.Speed boost: Adds PR × 5 ft. to one of the user's Speeds.
summaries.Turret, hidden: Adds concealed hardpoints to a vehicle housing.
summaries.Vehicle defense system: Drops an obstacle that forces pursuers into Maneuver checks.
summaries.Voice control: Operate the gadget by spoken command.
summaries.Weather control, constrained: Calls up weather effects up to its PR, including floods and storms.
summaries.Weather control, apocalyptic: Calls up any weather effect up to its PR.
summaries.X-ray vision: See through scenery and people up to a total Damage save of PR × 8.
summaries.Bag full of guns: Each character rolls for a random, slightly unreliable weapon.
summaries.Medical assistance: A doctor joins the team in the field for up to 24 hours.
summaries.Feat training: One temporary feat for the mission; request in the Intel Phase.
summaries.Manhunt: A police detective runs a manhunt on the team's behalf.
summaries.Skill training: Temporary skill ranks for the mission, split over up to 3 skills.
summaries.Smuggling: Gets one item of the same Caliber past a border or checkpoint.
summaries.Unmarked weapon (melee, handgun, hurled): Strips identifying marks from one melee, hurled or hand weapon.
summaries.Unmarked weapon (rifle, shotgun, SMG): Strips identifying marks from one rifle, shotgun or SMG.
summaries.Unmarked weapon (any other): Strips identifying marks from one weapon of any other kind.
summaries.Work group: A specialist team returns one skill check made as if taking 20.
summaries.Animal, trained: A trained animal worth up to PR × 10 XP.
summaries.Guided/indirect strike: Calls a vehicle-weapon strike on one 5-ft. square.
summaries.Hospitalization, public: Hospital care that speeds recovery; visitors can reach the patient.
summaries.Hospitalization, private: Private hospital care that speeds recovery.
summaries.Reconnaissance, broad: Exterior photos of up to 4 blocks; search them at −6.
summaries.Reconnaissance, narrow: Exterior photos of one block; search them at −3.
summaries.Reconnaissance, keyhole: Exterior photos of one building; search them at no penalty.
summaries.Body, corpse: One corpse, for whatever the team has planned.
summaries.Body double: A lookalike bystander who fails any forensic comparison.
summaries.Body, clone: A forensically exact copy of one person; knows only what it is told.
summaries.Phone line trace: Narrows a call's origin with repeated Investigation checks.
summaries.Cell phone dump: One person's call records for the past 24 hours.
summaries.Civilians, gaggle: A crowd of ordinary NPCs who focus on one target for the scene.
summaries.Civilians, swarm: A larger crowd of ordinary NPCs focused on one target.
summaries.Translator: An academic with two Cultures focuses helps for the scene.
summaries.Acid, mild: One dose of acid: 1d6 per PR, armor-piercing equal to 2 × PR.
summaries.Acid, commercial: One dose of acid: 1d6 per PR, armor-piercing equal to 2 × PR.
summaries.Acid, corrosive: One dose of acid: 1d6 per PR, armor-piercing equal to 2 × PR.
summaries.Acid, concentrated: One dose of acid: 1d6 per PR, armor-piercing equal to 2 × PR.
summaries.Acid, industrial: One dose of acid: 1d6 per PR, armor-piercing equal to 2 × PR.
summaries.Flare gun: Lights a wide area at night, or signals visibly for miles.
summaries.Grapple gun, standard: Shoots a climbing line onto a ledge (ranged attack, DC 20).
summaries.Grapple gun, winch: Grapple line with a winch that reels one person in quickly.
summaries.Medical gear, blood expander: Stops bleeding with a half action.
summaries.Medical gear, liquid skin patch: Restores some vitality with a half action; no wounds.
summaries.Medical gear, antibiotic shot: +2 to Fortitude saves against disease for 1d4 days.
summaries.Medical gear, antivenin shot: +2 to Fortitude saves against poison for 1d4 days.
summaries.Medical gear, atropine shot: Stabilizes a dying character with a half action.
summaries.Medical gear, stimulant shot: Holds off fatigue for 4 hours, after which it catches up.
summaries.Security device: One security device rated for the team's Threat Level.
summaries.Drone, security: A Tier III security drone that works for the team.
summaries.Lodging, 1-star hotel/flop house: One night's lodging for the team, booked under a false name.
summaries.Lodging, 2-star hotel/rectory: One night's lodging for the team, booked under a false name.
summaries.Lodging, 3-star hotel/loft: One night's lodging for the team, booked under a false name.
summaries.Lodging, 4-star hotel/ranch house: One night's lodging for the team, booked under a false name.
summaries.Lodging, 5-star hotel/mansion: One night's lodging for the team, booked under a false name.
summaries.Invitation, local gathering: Invitations for the whole team to an exclusive local event.
summaries.Invitation, regional gathering: Invitations for the whole team to an exclusive regional event.
summaries.Invitation, international gathering: Invitations for the whole team to an exclusive international event.
summaries.Code: A code, with up to 3 coding and 3 decoding devices.
summaries.Cover identity: A personal false identity; its PR sets Lifestyle and how well it holds.
summaries.Detention: Holds one captured enemy in a Faction safe house for a few days.
summaries.Dossier: Public-record file on one NPC; helps against their cover and in conflicts.
summaries.Fiberscope: Fiber-optic viewer for looking through a small hole.
summaries.Field glasses: Tripod optics that extend visual range; take vision upgrades.
summaries.Legal help, immunity: The Faction covers one future crime this mission, with GC approval.
summaries.Legal help, pardon: Erases one illegal act from the record and frees jailed members.
summaries.Legal help, warrant: Legal access to one residence or organization and its records.
summaries.Camera, still (consumer-grade): Still camera; extra film costs a Common Item per load.
summaries.Camera, video (consumer-grade): Video camera; extra film costs a Common Item per load.
summaries.Tape recorder (consumer-grade): Audio recorder; extra cassettes cost a Common Item each.
summaries.Camera, still (commercial-grade): Still camera; extra film costs a Common Item per load; takes vision upgrades.
summaries.Camera, video (commercial-grade): Video camera; extra film costs a Common Item per load; takes vision upgrades.
summaries.Tape recorder (commercial-grade): Audio recorder; extra cassettes cost a Common Item each.
summaries.Camera, still (professional-grade): Still camera; extra film costs a Common Item per load; takes vision upgrades.
summaries.Camera, video (professional-grade): Video camera; extra film costs a Common Item per load; takes vision upgrades.
summaries.Tape recorder (professional-grade): Audio recorder; extra cassettes cost a Common Item each.
